saw_lines: Course buyers hire a teacher for one result, then judge in the first minute whether that person has actually done it.
So the sale is won or lost in the first ad line, where proof either shows up or never gets seen.
Your site shows 200+ reviews each week, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number. Put the 200+ figure in the first line of every ad.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 26 Nov 2026
points: Your site shows 200+ reviews each week, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, so strangers get no reason to buy. Put the 200+ figure on the creative and in the first line, open two ads with review quotes.

Your 25 copy ads use 19 different openings, and the biggest, the dopamine addiction hook, leads only 2. Viewers never see one story twice, so none builds recognition. Pick the two strongest stories and build the next batch from them.

27 of your 30 ads have run 60+ days, so the core creative has lasted. Build three more variations of the oldest winner, changing only the opening line, so each new version tests one thing against a proven base.

You run 21 Learn more ads and 7 Apply now ads, so a viewer gets two different asks. Keep the cohort videos on Apply now, and send every focus opener to the 7-day course so the free ask matches its page.

ads_1: Focus hook variations opening on a review quote, tested against the oldest winner
